title: SnowmanBro
description: Take control of your own snowman buddy, launch snowballs, and turn your world into a chaotic snowball fight playground.
body:
This Mod was made for the [WinterJam-2025](https://winterjam.tophatcat.dev/)


### **Meet your new chilly companion: Snowmanbro.**

This mod lets you command your own snowman buddy with simple, clear orders:

- ATTACK
- DEFEND
- FOLLOW
- STAY

Turn ordinary snow golems into reliable partners for snowball fights, base defense, or just wandering the world by your side.

### Features
Snowman buddy AI
Turn a snowman into your personal Snowmanbro.

- Attack mode
 Command: ATTACK
 Your snowman focuses on nearby targets.
 
- Defend mode
 Command: DEFEND
 Snowmanbro protects you.
 
- Follow mode
 Command: FOLLOW
 Your snowman walks behind you, ready to switch to attack or defend.

- Stay mode
 Command: STAY
 Snowmanbro holds position and waits for your next order.
 Useful for setting up defensive lines or decorating builds with “live” snowmen.

### **How to Play**
### 
1.Get the custom snowball item
Use the custom Snowmanbro snowball item (check your recipes!!).

2.Spawn your Snowmanbro
Throw the custom snowball. When it lands, it spawns your Snowmanbro snowman at the impact location.

3.Link the remote

4.Hold the remote control item.
    Use it on the Snowmanbro to link the remote to that snowman.
Once linked, that remote will control this specific Snowmanbro.

5.Issue commands via the remote 

- Use the remote control to cycle through or select modes:
- ATTACK – Snowmanbro hunts and attacks targets.
- DEFEND – Snowmanbro stays near and protects you.
- FOLLOW – Snowmanbro walks behind you like a pet/companion.
- STAY – Snowmanbro holds position and waits for your next order.

Enjoy snowball battles 🎅
